svg.text: THE EDITABLE ANCHOR IS THE SEARCH FIELD.
NO SEPARATE SEARCH HEADER INSIDE THE POPUP.
INPUT MINIMUM FITS PLACEHOLDER AND DISPLAYED VALUE.
WT IS CALLER-SET; WP HUGS ROWS, UP TO MW.
OPEN: SELECTED / LAST MULTI VALUE, ELSE FIRST ENABLED.
QUERY: FIRST MATCH; POINTER EXIT KEEPS ACTIVE ROW.
SINGLE CHECK MOUNTS ONLY WHEN SELECTED.
MULTI KEEPS LIST OPEN; BLUR SHOWS COUNT SUMMARY.
GROUP HEADINGS HIDE WITH THEIR EMPTY SECTIONS.
EMPTY MESSAGE REPLACES THE COLLAPSED LIST.
SIZES SM / MD FLOW INTO FIELD AND ROWS.
ROW HEIGHT IS A MINIMUM; CUSTOM CONTENT MAY GROW.
ENVELOPE = MAXIMUM OF TWO SHADOW LAYERS.
NOMINAL BLUR EXTENT; CSS HAS NO HARD SHADOW EDGE.
REFERENCE WT = WP = 224; H3 = 250 AT N = 8.
WIDTH IS NOT A FIXED COMPONENT DIMENSION.
ACTIVE FILL AND SELECTED CHECK ARE INDEPENDENT.
NO LEADING ICON → OMIT I1 AND ITS S3.
SINGLE UNSELECTED → LABEL USES CHECK SPACE.
MULTI: CHECK REMAINS MOUNTED WHILE UNSELECTED.
SCALE 1:1 · GROUP HEIGHT USES INHERITED LH
GROUP: S6 + LH + S7; H3 ADDS EACH HEADING.
PROPORTIONAL SCHEMATIC · VERTICAL SEPARATION NOT TO SCALE
SCROLLBAR OVERLAYS THE LIST; FIELD KEEPS FOCUS.
PLAIN: NO BORDER / PAD; ICON + S3 RESERVED.
LEADING ICON SWAPS TO SEARCH WHILE FOCUSED.
WP = HUG ROWS, MINIMUM WT, MAXIMUM MW.
SCROLL VIEWPORT CAP MH; SCROLLBAR OVERLAYS.
COLLISIONS MAY FLIP OR SHIFT THE POPUP.
V1 IS NOT SET EXPLICITLY BY THIS WRAPPER.

Theme spacing, radii, typography and glass; live hydrated open-panel measurement.
